$comment: Survival tuning, GAME_DESIGN.md section 4 (the middle tier). Every number a designer would reach for lives here; Vitals.ts contains no literals.
$comment_regenHungerFloor: Regen scales with hunger rather than switching off. At full hunger you get the whole rate; at empty you get this fraction of it, then starvingRegenMultiplier on top. A player who cannot regen at all cannot walk home to eat.
$comment_faint: GAME_DESIGN.md section 4: the player collapses and wakes at their last bed. They wake with a fraction of health so they are not immediately at risk again, and with hunger untouched, because the walk back to your satchel is meant to be the cost.
